title: Continue to handle notifications even when Notifications tray icon is disabled
line: Notifications keep working when the Notifications entry of the System Tray is disabled or there is no Notifications widget at all.
explanation: The notification server and the popups live in the Notifications widget's shared Globals singleton, which was only created when a Notifications widget was loaded, and popups were only placed relative to a widget. Disabling the tray entry (or having no such widget) left org.freedesktop.Notifications without an owner, so notifications were silently lost. plasmashell (desktop shell only) now loads the widget's plugin and creates the Globals singleton on the shared QML engine at startup, passing the primary screen's available area so popups can be placed without a widget; when a widget exists it is still followed as before. The System Tray warning saying notifications would stop is removed.

commits.message:
shell: keep handling notifications without a Notifications widget

Disabling the Notifications tray entry stopped all notifications, since
only the widget loaded their shared state. plasmashell now loads it too
and places popups on the primary screen, so drop the warning about it.

BUG: 485383

media.caption: Pure master, Notifications tray entry disabled and plasmashell restarted: org.freedesktop.Notifications has no owner, a notification is sent and nothing appears
With the fix, same setup: the notification pops up in the bottom-right corner above the panel
With the fix, entry disabled at runtime through System Tray Settings (widget unloaded in the running session): notifications still pop up
